data.question: Must a contribution name a screen?
data.why: The code shape demanded screens for every kind of work, so backend work had no honest way in (14 of 28 build commits blocked), and the screen register the grade checked was not the project's own model.

options.what: No: screens are optional for work that touches no screen, provided it names what it does touch; ids are checked against the project's own Map

data.label: Screens are optional for work that touches no screen, provided it names what it does touch, and ids are checked against the project's own Map.
